Name: Giant Vanilla Flowers
Author: OrchidCourage
Description:
[b]Important: if you are using the 'Custom' sprite set, I recommend you make a backup of the folder before updating this mod, as the folder may be replaced with the default contents when you update.[/b]

I couldn't find any giant flower mods for vanilla flowers that worked in 1.6, so I made one!

Translations are supported, however currently there is only a file for english. If anyone would like to create translation files for other languages, please send them to me so I can add them.

All giant flowers are broken with an axe, same as regular giant crops, and will drop a customisable amount of flowers.

If you would also like giant versions of vanilla crops to go with your flowers, I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]Giant Crops by 6480[/url], which was invaluable for giving me a template to make this.

Currently the mod contains 4 sets of sprites that you can pick between: 'Vanilla' which is scaled up vanilla sprites, 'BBR' which were made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bahbahrah?gameId=1303]Bahbahrah[/url] and used in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10751]their giant flower mod[/url], 'Neo' which were made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51553461]NeonixWyd[/url] and used in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6653]their giant flower mod[/url], and 'Orchid Courage' which are made by me (I apologise for my lack of art skills).

If you would prefer to use your own sprites, or a mix of sprites from the included sets, replace the placeholder images in the 'Custom' folder under 'assets' and select 'Custom' in the mod config.

The requirements for new sprites are:
[list]
[*]48x64 pixels
[*]PNG format
[*]Named the flower they are for, with the first letter of each word capitalised ('Tulip', 'Fairy Rose', etc.)
[/list]
